operation_details.item: Earlier, the user planned an influencer-led content strategy.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Hey, how's the content plan coming along? I remember you were deep in strategy work last week.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: It's going well, actually. I shifted gears a bit — we're now leaning into a user-generated content strategy instead of the influencer-led approach I had earlier. The community research really changed my mind.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Oh, interesting! What made the community research point you in that direction?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: People kept saying they trusted real customer experiences way more than polished influencer posts. That was the push I needed.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. So did you completely scrap the influencer plan, or is it still floating around?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: We're not going with it. The whole strategy is outlined in the content plan now, and it's all UGC-focused. Feels much more authentic for our audience.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Got it. So the content plan is basically your go-to document for this now?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. If anyone asks, it's all there — the rationale, the formats, the rollout. The influencer thing is just not part of it anymore.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only my earlier influencer-led plan and retain the current UGC strategy and its rationale.
